player_prompt.intro:
Aweyiɣaɣa Player {player_id} le JoJoJoin, aweyiɣaɣa pɛɛlɛŋga 5x5 ɛjaɖɛ kɩgaŋga 0-24.
Aweyiɣaɣa wɛɛ tɛm, tɛmɛɛ kɛ kɛŋga kɩgaŋga, pɛɛlɛŋga '[12]'.
Aweyiɣaɣa WINI le kɛ kɛŋga naŋgbaŋga wɛɛ kɛ kɛŋga pɛɛlɛŋga naŋgbaŋga — naŋgbaŋga kɛŋga wɛɛ kɛ kɛŋga kɩgaŋga, kɩgaŋga, kɩgaŋga.
Aweyiɣaɣa Player {player_id} a wɛɛ '{symbol}'; aweyiɣaɣa kɩgaŋga a wɛɛ '{opponent_symbol}'.
